vetSays.line: 🛡️ Angelo, Marvin, Patrick and Colin met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Angelo, Marvin, Colin are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Angelo, Marvin and Colin met them at the door — 3 put down. Angelo, Marvin, Colin are hurt.
🛡️ Marvin, Sigrun, Lucas and Carlos met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Marvin, Lucas, Carlos are hurt.
🛡️ Sigrun, Lucas, Tariq, Bodhi and Thabo met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Sigrun, Lucas, Tariq, Bodhi, Thabo are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Boris was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Bodhi taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Bodhi drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bodhi just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Tariq, Bodhi and Mara met them at the door — 3 put down. Tariq, Bodhi, Mara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Erick just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Erick and James met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Erick, James are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ethan met them at the door — 1 put down. Ethan is hurt.
Ethan: "Walked past a good stand of ground elder. Worth remembering where."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethan just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ethan met them at the door — 1 put down.
